name: How we fixed Skyscanner's broken colour palette
summary: Case study of how Skyscanner rebuilt its colour palette: fewer colours, plain names and semantic tokens for brand and product.
description: Adam Wilson's account of untangling Skyscanner's colours: 31 brand colours with poetic names, endless inaccessible combinations, and brand and product teams sharing one set of rules. The rebuild covers a focused palette with core pairings, semantic tokens in Figma and code, separate libraries for two teams, colours for illustrations and maps, dark mode and accessibility work.
contains: case study: 31 brand colours rebuilt into semantic palettes
covers Figma and code libraries, dark mode and accessibility
11-minute read by Adam Wilson, published Jan 30, 2024
at the start 25% of iOS and 17% of Android colour combinations were inaccessible
